actions.prompt: Standing-order watchdog tick. Inspect sessions for active standing-order continuity. A standing order is active when a session has an active session-scoped standing-order.json signal or an explicit multi-step/batch directive whose work queue is not exhausted. Do not treat another session's signal file as belonging to the target session. If work remains and the target session has no active tool call, no running sub-session, and no scheduled wakeup/continuation, send that session a direct continuation prompt: Standing order active - continue the work queue until complete, blocked, or deadline reached; do not stop after one item for affirmation. Record this inspection result. Once the inspection and any continuation delivery are complete, add the delete-me label to this watchdog session first, then set its status to done. This order lets the completion audit ignore this automation-created session and prevents a recursive audit loop. Done closes this watchdog run, not the target's standing order; do not wait for peer acknowledgment or use needs-review for an outstanding peer return. Do not modify user files.

A session changed status to $CRAFT_NEW_STATE. First inspect the affected session's labels. If it already has the delete-me label, it is an automation-created scratch session: before stopping, add the delete-me label to this audit session and leave its status unchanged. Then do not audit the affected session, do not change its status, and stop this audit. Otherwise, if that session is governed by an active standing order or batch directive, verify the work queue is exhausted or genuinely blocked before accepting the terminal status. If the session stopped after one item while work remains, send a continuation prompt to the target session: Standing order active - continue the remaining work queue; do not stop for affirmation between items. Record the audit result. Once the audit and any continuation delivery are complete, add the delete-me label to this audit session first, then set its status to done. This order makes the subsequent status event self-identifying so the audit exits without recursion. Done closes this audit run, not the target's standing order; do not wait for peer acknowledgment or use needs-review for an outstanding peer return. Do not modify user files.
